+import numpy as np
+import mw_tool
+
+
+def move_mocap(s, target, grip=-1.0, dwell=0, label=""):
+    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
+    for _ in range(100):
+        delta = target - s.state()["mocap_pos"]
+        if np.max(np.abs(delta)) < 0.002:
+            break
+        action = np.r_[np.clip(delta / 0.01, -1, 1), grip]
+        s.step(action)
+    for _ in range(dwell):
+        s.step([0, 0, 0, grip])
+    st = s.state()
+    print(label, s.check()["control_steps"], "mocap", np.round(st["mocap_pos"], 3),
+          "tcp", np.round(st["tcp"], 3), "obj", np.round(st["object_pos"], 3),
+          "dist", round(s.check()["obj_to_target"], 3), flush=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    s = mw_tool.Session("/app/instance.npz")
+    obj = s.state()["object_pos"]
+    goal = s.state()["target_pos"]
+    print("start", obj, goal, flush=True)
+    move_mocap(s, [obj[0], obj[1] + 0.095, 0.2], -1, 8, "above")
+    move_mocap(s, [obj[0], obj[1] + 0.095, 0.078], -1, 10, "behind")
+    for i in range(35):
+        st = s.state()
+        if s.check()["success"]:
+            break
+        # Pad on the near side of the hand should contact the cube's far face.
+        direction = goal[:2] - st["object_pos"][:2]
+        direction /= np.linalg.norm(direction)
+        action = [float(direction[0]), float(direction[1]), 0.0, -1.0]
+        s.step(action)
+        if i % 5 == 4:
+            print("push", i+1, np.round(s.state()["object_pos"], 3),
+                  np.round(s.state()["tcp"], 3), round(s.check()["obj_to_target"], 3), flush=True)
+    print("final", s.check(), flush=True)
+    if s.check()["success"]:
+        s.save_trajectory()
+        print("saved", flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
